Thanks Marissa — great news. A few items to tick off from HR before we confirm the start date: 

- Candidate authorization form (background check consent) — we generally use DocuSign for this. If Chitra is outside the US for any portion of the last 7 years, add international checks (criminal + education verification).
- I-9 and right-to-work docs need to be collected before the first payroll run (if US-based). Please request a scanned copy of passport/drivers license and a completed I-9 when relevant.
- Employment verification: our vendor (cc'd) can contact FormerCorp directly, but we need the direct HR contact name/number if you have it.

Marissa — can you: 1) send candidate the DocuSign link and ID upload instructions, 2) confirm whether we should include international checks (candidate has listed prior employment in India), and 3) confirm laptop/os requirements for provisioning?

NEED BY: candidate auth signed within 48 hours to keep start date May 3. If candidate prefers earlier start date, we'll need express clearance.

Vivek

Subject: Re: Preboarding: authorization & scope for Chitra Rao (candidate)

Hi Marissa / Vivek,

Thanks for the intro — HireCheck here. We can run the standard employment + criminal + education checks, plus international verification in India. To proceed we need:

1) Candidate-signed authorization (DocuSign) OR attached signed PDF consent form.
2) Candidate's date of birth and current address (for criminal checks).
3) Copy of government ID for ID verification.
4) Contact info for FormerCorp HR if you prefer us to call them directly for employment verification.

Typical turnaround is 48–72 hours once we have signed authorization and the prior-employer contact. We will post results to the envelope link and send a PDF report.

Attached: sample_authorization_form.pdf (for your internal review).

Regards,

- Confirm your preferred start date (we've initially set May 3). If you'd like to start earlier, include the earliest date and any note on relocation.

- Day 1: 9:30am welcome + HR orientation, laptop setup, manager 1:1
- Day 2: team onboarding + infra walk-through

Let me know if you want a call to walk through the onboarding checklist.
